notes: U.S. operating bank subsidiary of Valley National Bancorp (NJ regional). Counterparty on Jared Kushner's 2018 Annual OGE Form 278e (Part 8 item 1) and Ivanka Trump's 2017 New Entrant OGE Form 278e (Part 8 item 1). Registered as a Part 8 third-party lender counterparty per Fork F §1 Decision 3 — operating-company test under Registry inclusion rule applies.
